skills.name: Code Review
skills.desc: Two-axis review of your diff: one pass against the repo's documented standards, one against the spec the work was meant to satisfy. The two run in parallel so neither colours the other.
skills.attribution: Built on the MIT-licensed review flow by Matt Pocock
skills.verificationNote: Free and MIT. Listed here because it is good and it runs on every platform - not for sale. Install it from the source.

skills.name: Grill With Docs
skills.desc: A relentless interview that sharpens a plan while it is still cheap to change, and leaves the decisions behind in a glossary and a stack of decision records.

skills.name: Test-Driven Development
skills.desc: The red-green-refactor loop, enforced. One failing test at a time, written before the code that makes it pass, and a full suite before the branch is called done.

skills.name: Prototype
skills.desc: Throwaway code with one job: answer a single design question you cannot settle on paper. Logic variant or interface variant, built to be discarded.
skills.attribution: Built on the MIT-licensed prototype skill by Matt Pocock
skills.verificationNote: Free and MIT. Listed here because it is good and it runs on every platform - not for sale. Install it from the source.
